# Build using existing grid and source shape.

proto=testproto

a=[row[:] for row in g]

  for pr,pc in shape:
   for qr,qc in frag:
    dr,dc=qr-pr,qc-pc
    placed={(r+dr,c+dc) for r,c in shape}
    if set(frag)<=placed and min(r for r,c in placed)>=0 and max(r for r,c in placed)<30 and min(c for r,c in placed)>=0 and max(c for r,c in placed)<30:
     opts.append((ori,placed,dr,dc))
 # Prefer horizontal reflection variant (1,0); if unavailable, use 180 rotation; then canonical identity
 pref=[(1,0),(0,2),(0,0)]
 targetori=next((o for o in pref if any(x[0]==o for x in opts)),opts[0][0])
 cand=[x for x in opts if x[0]==targetori]
 _,placed,_,_=cand[0]
 for r,c in frag:a[r][c]=1
 for r,c in placed:a[r][c]=color
out=a
print(len(out),set(map(len,out)),{c:sum(x==c for row in out for x in row) for c in range(2,10)})
